summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: @ornikar/kitt2@1.0.7 ships a preinstall hook that runs an obfuscated setup.mjs which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/*.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against an adjacent math_init.js (~727KB of Bun-compiled, control-flow-obfuscated code). The payload runs under Bun rather than Node, evading Node-based install-time inspection, and is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a Tamagui/Storybook UI kit whose actual dist output is a ~723-byte decorator). Both setup.mjs (obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling with per-function string-map objects) and math_init.js (shuffled numeric string array plus a rotator function) are heavily obfuscated. The package name @ornikar/kitt2 combined with a repository.url pointing to github.com/ornikar/kitt.git suggests impersonation of the real @ornikar/kitt scope. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
